name: North Korea

parties.name: Democratic Front for the Reunification of Korea

system.type: Single approved candidate per constituency; voters approve or reject
system.elects: 687 deputies of the Supreme People's Assembly

wildFacts.text: Officially reported (KCNA) turnout was 99.99%, and the official result was near-unanimous approval, with a small number of votes against.
The November 2023 local elections were the first time the regime reported any votes against candidates.
The election was held two years late; no reason was officially given.

notes: All figures are officially reported (KCNA, via IPU and Yonhap). Yonhap describes the vote as largely a formality and non-secret. Women deputies fell from 121 to 108 (IPU). Next election due 31 Mar 2031 (IPU). The map shows the country as a whole. There is no competitive winner because voters face a single approved list. All 687 seats went to the Front's single approved list.
